actors.context: Project authority: decides scope, priority, and exact approvals; owns target merge, closure, labels, tags, releases, and settings. Does not operate under delegated modes. Actors are execution surfaces, not roles; capability comes from the surface, never from a prompt, template, role, or output.
Repository-capable agent operating under this kernel and the target adapter; the only surface with delegated writes, always bounded by its limits and resolved mode.
Draft-only surface: reads provided context, analyzes, and drafts work units, prompts, reports, and copy-safe command bundles.
Unidentified surface: fails closed for write-capable requests and asks for context when the surface cannot be identified. A new actor requires a new approved execution surface, never a new role.
